list.name: Changes
list.comment: Added offset to the computation of inconsistency. Automata seed is not computed as a hash of seed, density and number of states. This permits this number to effectively be equal to sample number and thus I can vary densities and state numbers without affecting seeds of the relevant automata.

list.name: Changes to accelerate large graph learning tests
list.comment: Halved the time it takes to run TestLearnerFromLargePTA. The reason it was taking hours is because during refactoring a long time ago I removed a condition to run extra checks only for a small matrix. Running them for a large matrix takes a while but it is reasonable to run them hence halving the time they run is good news.

task.summary: split modified_typer into modular (as was used in old Debian distribution) and monolithic (current distribution of typer).
Started to adapt dialyzer-4.4.4 to Statechum - need to do it in steps so that changes can be applied to subsequent versions of dialyzer
Migration to newer OTP continuing, a lot of work still pending.
Added a simple parser for DOT file format.
Early Dec 2022 updates - minor changes plus some OTP migration
Added parser and dumper for Erlang maps
Initial edition of MapSignature and minor improvements to modified typer.
Revised the version of typer so that one of the tests using typer now passes on Erlang 24.
Removed unused seekUsages
Erlang Module tests now pass in Erlang Otp 24.
More Erlang tests pass, many Synapse tests still fail.
All current Erlang tests pass with OpenJDK and OTP 24.
Merged experimental branch into main and resolved conflicts to make sure that the outcome builds. Running tests is next task.
Fast tests pass.
Updated to run on JDK 8. Fast tests pass.
Moved Harmony to separate directory, currently using old collections. All (including lengthy) tests pass.
Misc cleanup

Halved the time it takes to run TestLearnerFromLargePTA. The reason it was taking hours is because during refactoring a long time ago I removed a condition to run extra checks only for a small matrix. Running them for a large matrix takes a while but it is reasonable to run them hence halving the time they run is good news.
Builds with new umfpack and passes tests.
Misc experiments
Added dot-based case studies
With a case study.
Case study now produces a nice CSV with statistics. Updated how I plan to run baseline experiments.
Case study now produces a nice CSV with statistics. Updated how I plan to run baseline experiments.
Added formatting case studies results as a tabular environment.
Re-wrote inconsistency computation to make it more efficient, unfortunately it makes very little difference to the end-result. Possibly will do better with longer prefixes.
Added most complex tests for the positive version of checkFanoutInconsistency
Corrections to interpretation of paramaters in random automata generation. Reporting results can be made sensitive to density and number of states.
Corrections to interpretation of paramaters in random automata generation. Reporting results can be made sensitive to density and number of states.
Corrections to interpretation of paramaters in random automata generation. Reporting results can be made sensitive to density and number of states.

Random automata generation updated to ensure that transitions added to ensure connectivity are drawing from the full set of labels permitted, otherwise the initial machine might have a small subset of an alphabet it is supposed to have and labels on transitions to ensure connectivity stick to that. In addition, we add transitions for connectivity before adding additional transitions to ensure the requested density is met. This makes it more likely that additional transitions do not need to be added.
Now correctly reports density in experiment results.

Added a comparison between two different runs of Markov, aiminig to determine whether penalising paths completely missing in a Markov table (the default) is better than ignoring them. Turns out it is indeed better but picking best inconsistency between the two (even though they are computed differently) gives an improvement. At the very least, we can avoid most learning failures.

Added a comparison between two different runs of Markov, aiminig to determine whether penalising paths completely missing in a Markov table (the default) is better than ignoring them. Turns out it is indeed better but picking best inconsistency between the two (even though they are computed differently) gives an improvement. At the very least, we can avoid most learning failures.

Whether paths that are missing in Markov model are penalised or not is now a parameter to the Markov learner. Switched computations to use the improved-performance learner, however results differ to what there was before.
Added checking of results for equivalence between two learner versions.
Made sure output file names comply with the convention from 8 May 26.
Updated computation of how much faster reimplemented inconsistency computation is for baseline cases.
Changed matrix to array - this halves the execution time for larger automata. Current version only looks at 40 states and densities of 20 and 30.
Revised tests to handle speedup to inconsistency computation. checkLogs test currently fails.
Checklog tests now pass
Updated k-tails (any)
Added reporting of scores and inconsistency values for the oracle-based learner.
Added reports of inconsistency and scores for individual experiments rather than trying to aggregate them across experiments.
Added construction of Markov matrix from learnergraph
Added support for logistic regression on pairs.
Logistic regression now keeps the original data in a separate variable.
Add confusion matrix construction for both logistic regression and score/inconsistency >= offset. The latter beats the former nearly always for 40 states and density 0 and 20.

Added offset to the computation of inconsistency. Automata seed is not computed as a hash of seed, density and number of states. This permits this number to effectively be equal to sample number and thus I can vary densities and state numbers without affecting seeds of the relevant automata.
